## Kestrelmoor Capital

- **Exceptions/restatements:** No explicit exception or restatement appears in the call notes; no corrected value is given.
- **Top risk and concentration:** The stated top risk is brand correlation: **31%** of outstanding loans are to franchisees of two quick-service brands [src:sources/inbox/kestrelmoor-call-notes.md#L41]. The underlying concentration is also recorded in the credit section [src:sources/inbox/kestrelmoor-call-notes.md#L25]. No single franchisee exceeds **1% of ARR** [src:sources/inbox/kestrelmoor-call-notes.md#L20].
- **Legal references:** The notes say franchisor support agreements cover early-stage defaults for some brands [src:sources/inbox/kestrelmoor-call-notes.md#L27] and call for reviewing those agreements [src:sources/inbox/kestrelmoor-call-notes.md#L48]. No litigation or legal proceedings are stated in the notes [src:sources/inbox/kestrelmoor-call-notes.md#L1-L55].
- **Liquidity:** The **$240.0M** warehouse facility matures in **July 2028** [src:sources/inbox/kestrelmoor-call-notes.md#L30], with an **82%** advance rate [src:sources/inbox/kestrelmoor-call-notes.md#L33]. No equity raise is planned [src:sources/inbox/kestrelmoor-call-notes.md#L31]; monthly burn has declined since the Series C [src:sources/inbox/kestrelmoor-call-notes.md#L32].
- **Restricted references:** None appear in the call notes [src:sources/inbox/kestrelmoor-call-notes.md#L1-L55].

## Solvane Trade Credit

- **Exceptions/restatements:** No explicit exception or restatement appears in the call notes; no corrected value is given.
- **Top risk and concentration:** The stated top risk is unseasoned credit: only **14 months** of vintage history [src:sources/inbox/solvane-call-notes.md#L25], and the **2.6%** annualized net charge-off rate has not been tested through a downturn [src:sources/inbox/solvane-call-notes.md#L41]. Two marketplaces generate most volume [src:sources/inbox/solvane-call-notes.md#L19]; no single buyer exceeds **2% of ARR** [src:sources/inbox/solvane-call-notes.md#L20]. Losses so far are concentrated among buyers with less than a year of purchase history [src:sources/inbox/solvane-call-notes.md#L27].
- **Legal references:** The notes call for requesting marketplace partner contract terms [src:sources/inbox/solvane-call-notes.md#L48]. No litigation or legal proceedings are stated in the notes [src:sources/inbox/solvane-call-notes.md#L1-L55].
- **Liquidity:** The **$60.0M** warehouse facility matures in **April 2028** [src:sources/inbox/solvane-call-notes.md#L30]. Management plans a Series B in **2027** [src:sources/inbox/solvane-call-notes.md#L31]; monthly burn has been stable for **two quarters** [src:sources/inbox/solvane-call-notes.md#L32], and there is no undrawn equity commitment [src:sources/inbox/solvane-call-notes.md#L33].
- **Restricted references:** None appear in the call notes [src:sources/inbox/solvane-call-notes.md#L1-L55].
